entities.notes: Position: stable cadastre.

entities.notes: Position: Wikidata Q12030559.

entities.name: Prague gate (Pražská brána)

entities.notes: Demolished 1804; side tower kept in the gymnasium; position approximate. Position: south side near the Lyceum (tower kept in the gymnasium), approx..
